title: Supplementary code and data for: Where wildlife is heard: AI-powered mapping of bird acoustic activity for adaptive monitoring and urban planning
description: Public supplementary materials, analysis code, aggregate processed data, model source and reproducibility workflow associated with a manuscript on AI-powered mapping of Asian Koel acoustic activity for adaptive monitoring and urban planning in Shenzhen. The archive includes the complete Supplementary Information, 17 independent tables and 10 figures.
